build_dataloader_from_args: build a dataloader from DataArgs config to load and iterate over JSONL dataset chunks
init_dataloader_state_from_args: initialize a PrefetchState from DataArgs for resuming data loading from a specific rank and world size
pack_tokens: pack token sequences into fixed-length chunks with sliding window views for model training
batch_and_shuffle_prefetched_sequences: prefetch and shuffle batches of token sequences to reduce correlation inside training batches
async_iterator: create an async producer-consumer iterator that prefetches data in a separate multiprocessing worker
